figurative_meaning_en: war of words, verbal sparring, argumentation
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বন্ধুর মধ্যে বাগযুদ্ধ শুরু হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A war of words has started between the two friends.
Everyone got engrossed in verbal sparring during the meeting.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday Bengali discourse to describe non-physical conflicts.
